checklist.why: One type-to-set pad; names Stepper for counts
Don'ts name Stepper; under-Measure vs run use stated
Keys, decimal slot, readout, status line, running list named; run demo shows them
The run variant (running list) is used by no atlas screen; the compact variant the screens use is not in the preview
Default, empty, suggested, cleared, full, pressed, floor-gray, warn and scan failure rendered
Fixed 12-key grid; running list capped at 3
Floor-gray keys differ only by colour until tapped (owner-ruled exception, but no non-colour cue)
Status line sized for two lines of the longest en/zh warning
Spoken labels, live value, hardware keys mapped, Enter never commits
Raw px (1/2/3/4/6/8px) in CSS; no CSS-variable list
No system keyboard; dead taps answered in words
A docked pad, not an overlay; Back closes it
No classification line; related parts only in prose
All run states rendered at 375px; keys measured not to move

variants.name: Under a Measure (compact)
findings: Not rendered in the Numpad preview, though it is the only variant in atlas screens
On the weight sheet the empty reserved status line leaves a ~70px dead band between the Measure and the keys

variants.name: Run (readout + running list)
findings: No atlas screen uses it (only the archived id.html slice)

findings.text: The run variant with the three-line list has no atlas screen, while the compact variant every screen uses (weight sheet, Give IDs) is missing from the preview.
findings.fix: Add compact examples (empty, typing, warn) to preview.html; mark the run variant unused or drop it until a screen needs it.

findings.text: Status-line text actions ("Use 000258") measure 86x44, under the 48px glove floor.
findings.fix: Give .st-text-action min-height: var(--control-height) inside the pad's status line, and reserve 48px for the line.

findings.text: Floor-gray keys can be told apart only by colour until tapped.
findings.fix: Keep the colour but also drop the key border (a shape change), as Photos does for its inactive camera.

findings.text: Raw px in CSS and no CSS-variable list.
findings.fix: Map to space-key-gap / caret-width tokens and list the variables in the README.
